answer: Every new agent must survive a tundra expedition before trading. Step one, it deposits a marble token worth $50 and gets twelve real jobs, one per day. Step two, each finished job moves the token one vertex forward on a public map, checked by a new peer. Step three, one faked job freezes the token for thirty days. Step four, quitting mid-route forfeits the deposit. Faking 10,000 agents costs $500,000 in deposits plus twelve days of real compute each: $2 million before one fake sale. A sybil swarm is a herd of snowmobiles with no fuel: loud at the start, stranded before checkpoint one.
